verdict.rationale: Braintrust documents an annotation area: custom annotation interfaces for team review workflows, and datasets built from user feedback and manual curation under /docs/annotate. That shows human review and labeling exist. Nothing in the evidence describes queues or routing outputs to reviewers. Missing for 10: explicit annotation queue feature, mechanism to route or filter outputs into review queues, reviewer assignment/workflow docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
